descriptors.name: after-task-id
descriptors.description: ID of the neighbor that should end up immediately AFTER the moved task — the moved task is placed just before it.
descriptors.helpText: ID of the neighbor that should end up immediately AFTER the moved task — the moved task is placed just before it. (--clear-after-task-id sends null)

descriptors.name: clear-after-task-id
descriptors.helpText: Send null for afterTaskId (mutually exclusive with --after-task-id)

descriptors.name: before-task-id
descriptors.description: ID of the neighbor that should end up immediately BEFORE the moved task — the moved task is placed just after it. Provide beforeTaskId and/or afterTaskId for placement; omit both to append to the end of the column.
descriptors.helpText: ID of the neighbor that should end up immediately BEFORE the moved task — the moved task is placed just after it. Provide beforeTaskId and/or afterTaskId for placement; omit both to append to the end of the column. (--clear-before-task-id sends null)

descriptors.name: clear-before-task-id
descriptors.helpText: Send null for beforeTaskId (mutually exclusive with --before-task-id)

descriptors.name: expected-updated-at
descriptors.description: Optimistic concurrency guard: the entity's updatedAt from your last read. If it changed since, the call fails with CONFLICT and the error embeds the current entity.
descriptors.helpText: Optimistic concurrency guard: the entity's updatedAt from your last read. If it changed since, the call fails with CONFLICT and the error embeds the current entity.

descriptors.name: task-id
descriptors.description: ID of the task to move.
descriptors.helpText: ID of the task to move.

descriptors.name: to-column-id
descriptors.description: Destination column (must belong to same board). Moving = changing status.
descriptors.helpText: Destination column (must belong to same board). Moving = changing status.
